question: How late can I be before I lose my appointment?
reference_answer: Under Policy POL-LAT-01, there are three late-arrival thresholds: (1) 0 to 15 minutes late (Grace Period): your full appointment proceeds with ₹0 penalty; (2) 16 to 25 minutes late (Moderate Delay): the dentist may perform a shortened diagnostic assessment or shift you to a same-day standby gap if chair time permits (₹0 fee same day, or ₹250 if rescheduled to a future date); and (3) More than 25 minutes late (Late-Arrival Forfeit): you lose your appointment slot and it is treated as a short-notice cancellation (<4 hours) under POL-CAN-01, forfeiting your ₹500 slot-hold deposit (or incurring a ₹500 fee on zero-deposit bookings).
bot_reply: You have a 15-minute grace period to arrive without any penalty [DENT-009]. If you arrive more than 25 minutes late, your appointment is considered forfeited and must be rescheduled, which incurs a ₹500 fee or the forfeiture of your ₹500 deposit [DENT-009][DENT-009].

question: Can I pay in cash, and is there a limit?
reference_answer: Yes, you can pay in Indian Rupees (INR) cash at the reception billing desk (PAY-04) with zero surcharge, subject to a hard cap of ₹1,99,999 per treatment episode under Section 269ST of the Income Tax Act. Providing your PAN is mandatory for cash payments of ₹50,000 or above.
bot_reply: Yes, you can pay in cash. The maximum limit is ₹199,999 per treatment episode [DENT-021]. Please note that a PAN is mandatory for cash payments of ₹50,000 or above [DENT-021].

question: What does policy POL-CAN-01 say?
reference_answer: Policy POL-CAN-01 (Appointment Cancellation & No-Show Policy) sets three cancellation notice tiers: (1) ≥ 24 hours before the appointment: free cancellation (₹0 fee; 100% refund of any ₹500 slot-hold deposit within 5 business days under REF-01); (2) 4 to < 24 hours before: ₹300 late cancellation fee (₹300 deducted from a ₹500 deposit with ₹200 refunded, or ₹300 added to your next visit on zero-deposit bookings); and (3) < 4 hours before or No-Show (>25 minutes late): full ₹500 slot-hold deposit forfeited (or ₹500 fee on zero-deposit bookings). Two consecutive no-shows in 12 months trigger mandatory ₹500 advance deposits for future bookings until two consecutive visits are attended on time.
bot_reply: Policy POL-CAN-01 governs appointment cancellations and no-shows at BrightSmile Dental Care to ensure fair access to clinical chair time [DENT-007][DENT-007]. It applies to all outpatient, preventive, restorative, endodontic, surgical, orthodontic, and cosmetic appointments across our four operatories [DENT-007]. Cancellations must be submitted via the web portal, reception phone, WhatsApp, or official email to be valid [DENT-007]. If you cancel at least 24 hours before your appointment, you receive a 100% refund of your slot-hold deposit (₹500) within 5 business days; if you cancel between 4 and 24 hours prior, a ₹300 fee is deducted [DENT-024].
human_note: Summary of POL-CAN-01 omits the <4-hour / no-show forfeiture tier and the repeat-no-show rule - the most consequential parts.

question: My 15-year-old son needs a braces adjustment. Can his grandmother bring him, and which days is the orthodontist in?
reference_answer: Yes, his grandmother can bring him for a routine follow-up braces adjustment (SRV-008), provided a biological parent or court-appointed legal guardian has already signed the Standing Written Guardian Authorization Form (FRM-PED-03) in person at the clinic naming her as an authorized adult escort (aged 18+), and she brings her valid Government Photo ID. Senior Consultant Orthodontist Dr. Meera Kulkarni is available on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays.

question: What does a crown cost?
reference_answer: The cost of a dental crown depends on the material selected: a Porcelain-Fused-to-Metal (PFM) Crown (SRV-006, 5-year lab warranty) costs ₹4,500 per tooth, while a Monolithic Zirconia Crown (SRV-006A, 10-year lab warranty) costs ₹9,500 per tooth (both GST-exempt under the 2026 Fee Schedule).
